extraction.Name: Sarah Colombe, formerly Sarah Prue
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded November 30, 1920 by the Volz Abstract Company; receipt for the same was signed by the allottee April 3, 1920
extraction.Buyer: Land mortgaged October 22, 1920 for $1,000; again October 14, 1922 for $100.00; again July 3, 1923 for $550.00; then by deed dated September 10, 1924 Sarah and her husband conveyed the land to John R. Martin for $3520.00, subject to existing encumbrances of record
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739683; land described as Lots 3 and 4 and the east half of the southwest quarter of section 7, township 98, range 78; mortgaged by Sarah Colombe Prue and her husband
